title: 游戏进程卡死与软锁
description: 玩家在游戏中遭遇无法推进的卡死状态，如投降后警察不逮捕、早期选择导致软锁等。
evidence: If you choose to surrender, the police still keeps yelling at you that you're under arrest, and from then on that's all he does. Just yell at you. Never arrests you, never attacks you, never does anything to progress the situation. Just stuck.
Most choices you make will likely result in either soft locking your self or out right dying.

evidence_items.quote: If you choose to surrender, the police still keeps yelling at you that you're under arrest, and from then on that's all he does. Just yell at you. Never arrests you, never attacks you, never does anything to progress the situation. Just stuck.
evidence_items.description: 投降后警察持续喊话但不逮捕也不攻击，导致游戏卡住无法推进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你选择投降，警察仍然会一直冲你喊你被捕了，从那以后他就只干这一件事。就只是冲你喊。从不逮捕你，从不攻击你，从不做任何推进局势的事。就卡在那里。

evidence_items.quote: Most choices you make will likely result in either soft locking your self or out right dying.
evidence_items.description: 早期游戏选择可能导致软锁或死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你做出的大多数选择很可能要么导致自己陷入软锁，要么直接死亡。
